verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Ollama serves a live llms.txt at https://ollama.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Supporting agent-friendly surfaces are thinner: the markdown docs variant (docs.md) and every OpenAPI spec path probed returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth/coverage (e.g., an llms-full.txt or linked docs index), a markdown docs variant, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of agents successfully using it.
